def find_deletion_pattern():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    n, m = map(int, data[0].split())
    filenames = data[1:n+1]
    indices_to_delete = list(map(int, data[n+1].split()))
    
    # Extract the files to be deleted based on the indices
    files_to_delete = [filenames[i-1] for i in indices_to_delete]
    
    if not files_to_delete:
        print("No")
        return
    
    # Start with the first file to determine the pattern
    pattern = list(files_to_delete[0])
    
    for i in range(1, len(files_to_delete)):
        current_file = files_to_delete[i]
        for j in range(len(pattern)):
            if j >= len(current_file) or pattern[j] != current_file[j]:
                pattern[j] = '?'
    
    # Ensure the pattern matches all files to be deleted
    for file in files_to_delete:
        if len(file) != len(pattern):
            print("No")
            return
        for j in range(len(pattern)):
            if pattern[j] != '?' and pattern[j] != file[j]:
                print("No")
                return
    
    # If we reach here, the pattern is valid
    print("Yes")
    print(''.join(pattern))

def find_deletion_pattern():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    n, m = map(int, data[0].split())
    files = data[1:n+1]
    indices_to_delete = list(map(int, data[n+1].split()))
    
    # Extract the files to be deleted based on the indices
    files_to_delete = [files[i-1] for i in indices_to_delete]
    
    # Check if all files to delete have the same length
    if len(set(len(f) for f in files_to_delete)) != 1:
        print("No")
        return
    
    # Initialize the pattern with the first file to delete
    pattern = list(files_to_delete[0])
    
    # Iterate over each file to delete and update the pattern
    for file in files_to_delete[1:]:
        for i in range(len(file)):
            if pattern[i] != '?' and pattern[i] != file[i]:
                pattern[i] = '?'
    
    # Join the pattern list to form the final pattern string
    pattern_str = ''.join(pattern)
    
    # Check if the pattern matches all files to delete and no others
    for file in files:
        if file in files_to_delete:
            if not all(p == '?' or p == f for p, f in zip(pattern_str, file)):
                print("No")
                return
        else:
            if all(p == '?' or p == f for p, f in zip(pattern_str, file)):
                print("No")
                return
    
    # If all checks passed, print "Yes" and the pattern
    print("Yes")
    print(pattern_str)
